name: Lingchen Kong
headline: M.S. Student in Space Physics
bio:
I am a Master student in the school of Earth and Space Science and Technology, Wuhan University. I received my B.S. degree at School of Electronic Information, Wuhan University in 2024.

My research interest lies at array & radar signal processing, spectral analysis and adaptive filtering theory. My aim is to develop novel signal processing and machine learning techniques and apply them to 6G wireless communication, Integrated Sensing and Communication(ISAC), radar system for robotics and autonomus. 

I am also eager at sharing my knowledge to others through open-source projects. I think researchers should be transparent with each other and collaborate for the development of humankind.
interests:
Array & Radar Signal Processing
Spectral Analysis
Adaptive Filtering Theory
Machine Learning
